source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 广大医务人员是最美的天使
topics.official_english: Medical workers are the most beautiful angels
topics.why_hot: A widely shared phrase paying tribute to medical workers, resonating amid ongoing public appreciation for healthcare staff.
topics.share_angle: Highlight the dedication of medical workers and public gratitude, using the phrase as a positive lead.

topics.chinese_topic: 富士康紧急扩招 新人入职就奖8800元
topics.official_english: Foxconn launches urgent recruitment drive with 8,800 yuan sign-on bonus for new hires
topics.why_hot: Foxconn's big sign-on bonus signals a surge in manufacturing labor demand, drawing attention to jobs and the economy.
topics.share_angle: Explain why Foxconn is hiring urgently and what the bonus says about the current job market and electronics supply chain.

topics.chinese_topic: 公积金新政来了 有哪些利好
topics.official_english: New housing provident fund policies announced: what are the benefits?
topics.why_hot: Changes to the housing provident fund affect many workers' ability to buy or rent homes, making it a livelihood hot topic.
topics.share_angle: Break down the policy changes and explain how they might help ordinary home buyers and renters.

topics.chinese_topic: 男子花1290万买精装豪宅竟是样板间
topics.official_english: Man buys luxury furnished apartment for 12.9 million yuan, then finds it was the model room
topics.why_hot: A stunning consumer dispute raises questions about property sales transparency and buyers' rights.
topics.share_angle: Use this case to discuss what home buyers should check before signing contracts and how to protect consumer rights.

topics.chinese_topic: 北大报到日校园满是扛床垫的爸
topics.official_english: Peking University registration day: campus full of fathers carrying mattresses
topics.why_hot: A warm, relatable scene at a top university's registration day shows parental care and the start of campus life.
topics.share_angle: Reflect on family support, Chinese college entrance traditions, and the bittersweet moment of leaving home.

topics.chinese_topic: 日本民众排队5小时买中国相机
topics.official_english: Japanese shoppers queue five hours to buy Chinese-made cameras
topics.why_hot: Chinese camera brands gaining popularity in Japan sparks national pride and questions about the global tech market.
topics.share_angle: Examine how Chinese consumer electronics are going global and what makes these cameras so attractive to Japanese buyers.

topics.chinese_topic: 大学生一个月给多少生活费合适
topics.official_english: How much monthly allowance should college students get?
topics.why_hot: A perennial family debate about student budgets, touching on education costs, living standards, and financial literacy.
topics.share_angle: Compare different living-cost levels and give tips on how students can budget and manage money.

topics.chinese_topic: AI演员能替代真人演员吗
topics.official_english: Can AI actors replace human actors?
topics.why_hot: As AI-generated performances improve, the entertainment industry and audiences are debating the future of acting.
topics.share_angle: Explore both sides: the efficiency of AI actors versus the irreplaceable emotional depth of human performers.
